_note: Without a Svelte config the language server transpiles `<script lang="ts">` with TypeScript before compiling, and drops a parse error whose message contains "expected" when any script, style or template tag has a `lang` attribute: neither SuppressedSyntaxError nor StyleLangSuppresses (a plain script beside `<style lang="scss">`) gets a `js_parse_error`. Errors the transpile keeps still come through at the mapped position (a redeclared const); the transpile rewrites legacy octal literals and removes a namespace holding only types, so those parse. Verified against upstream svelte-check.
